title: Pokémon Pokopia Multiplayer: Online, Local Wireless, GameShare, and Co-building
description: Pokémon Pokopia supports online and local wireless multiplayer for up to four players, plus GameShare, Palette Town co-building, Cloud Island, and read-only Virtual Mode.
source: Nintendo News - How multiplayer works
keywords: Pokémon Pokopia Multiplayer: Online, Local Wireless, GameShare, and Co-building Pokémon Pokopia supports online and local wireless multiplayer for up to four players, plus GameShare, Palette Town co-building, Cloud Island, and read-only Virtual Mode. Official Source Roundup Official source roundup Nintendo says Pokémon Pokopia supports online and local wireless ways to play with friends.,Nintendo's launch article says players can invite up to three other players to visit.,Nintendo says town visits start through the Pokémon Center PC's Link Play menu, which unlocks after roughly 30 minutes of play.,Visitors to a town are in Spectator Mode, so their actions are limited and they cannot freely alter the host's creations.,Palette Town is described as a large sandbox area where Spectator Mode can be turned off so players can build, craft, discover Pokémon, and make habitats together.,Nintendo says GameShare can let people without the game access a shared area, with Nintendo Switch 2 required to initiate the session.,Cloud Island is described as a persistent online area with its own Pokédex, rewards, and challenges.,Virtual Mode lets players share a Cloud Island online while preventing visitors from changing it. This page is useful because multiplayer rules are easy to misunderstand. It separates town visiting, Palette Town building, GameShare, Cloud Island, and Virtual Mode into distinct concepts.,When writing future multiplayer guides, avoid implying that every visitor can edit every town. Nintendo specifically describes Spectator Mode for normal town visits.,GameShare details depend on Nintendo Switch 2, GameChat, Nintendo Switch Online, and session limits, so link to Nintendo rather than paraphrasing all restrictions in every article.
